quote.text: By their fruits ye shall know them.
quote.author: The Gospel of Matthew 7:16, King James Version, 1611

stories.headline: Hestra’s own product feed says its grail peccary gloves are sewn in Hungary
stories.dek: All eight table-cut peccary and carpincho pairs on its US store, at $525 to $625, are attributed to a Hungarian glovers’ co-operative; the only Swedish supplier on the list makes the leather balm.

stories.headline: Samsung and SK hynix post record quarters; chips make 99% of Samsung’s profit
stories.dek: Chips produced 106.5 trillion won of Samsung’s 107.4tn operating profit on 29 October — while the division that makes its phones ran a loss of 0.8tn paying those prices.

stories.headline: Sri Lanka cut a million families from Aswesuma while the rupee outlay rose
stories.dek: The roll fell from 2,439,917 beneficiary families in 2025 to 1,251,522 in August 2026 — and the monthly payment went from Rs 11.2bn in November to Rs 11.83bn in July.

stories.headline: Lagarde quits the ECB nine months early as euro-zone inflation hits 3.8%
stories.dek: The bank said on Thursday she leaves on 7 February 2027; its Governing Council had held the deposit rate at 2.50 per cent hours before, with energy prices up 18.9 per cent on the year.

stories.headline: HDB drops 1,200 homes at Maju Forest and Gillman Barracks after 9,500 submissions
stories.dek: Alvin Tan said on 28 October the two sites will now yield about 11,000 homes over a decade, with retained greenery at Maju Forest up from roughly 8ha to 10ha.

stories.headline: Apple put touch on the MacBook Pro and charged Singapore S$1,000 extra
stories.dek: The MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display was announced on 28 October at S$3,999 to S$6,499; pre-orders open here today, with machines in stores on 6 November.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Last Collaboration
stories.headline: Habring² and SJX priced their final collaboration at US$28,500 for thirty watches
stories.dek: The Chrono Felix Perpetual “Star”, published on 29 October, is a 38.5mm steel monopusher with a perpetual-calendar module, a 40 per cent deposit and deliveries from January 2027.

stories.headline: Fielder and Oppenheim’s Holmes documentary grew 25% in weekend two to $19.5m
stories.dek: A24’s You Can See Everything has taken $45.1m in ten days, from 855 sites to 2,655, at 97 per cent from 195 critics.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Window At Thirteen
stories.headline: Jason Nagata’s ABCD cohort puts the depression link at thirteen, not twelve
stories.dek: Jason Nagata’s five-wave analysis of 11,279 children in the ABCD study puts the effect at β .06 by fourteen — and finds nothing at all for anxiety, in any year.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Pause And The Print
stories.headline: Warsh’s Fed held, then September PCE accelerated to 3.6% and GDP printed 3.4%
stories.dek: The committee voted ten to two on 28 October, with Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissenting to raise; a month ago the market put a December increase below one chance in ten.

stories.kicker: The Rabbit Hole · Gliding And Soaring
stories.headline: James Payne took a sailplane to 22,657 metres over Argentina with no engine
stories.dek: Gliding runs on four kinds of rising air. A modern eighteen-metre racer was measured at 57 to 1 by Idaflieg, and the straight-distance record is 3,008 kilometres.

stories.kicker: Fitness · The Curve That Does Not Flatten
stories.headline: Mayo Clinic Proceedings finds fitness keeps paying past 44 ml/kg/min
stories.dek: A UK Biobank analysis of 10,462 adults puts fifteen-year survival between 39.3 and 77.4 per cent across the fitness range — while grip strength stops paying at the median of 32kg.

stories.headline: Disney On Ice opens its Singapore presale on 4 November, general sale the 25th
stories.dek: The Kallang’s own page already flags one seat tier as limited for a March 2027 run — and the Australian Open’s early-bird pricing closes at 12.59pm on 30 November.
